verdict.rationale: First-party docs say a project organizes related chats and gives ChatGPT the context it needs, and a local project gives those chats shared access to folders of files on your computer. Configuration such as MCP servers can also be scoped to a project. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of project-level shared custom instructions (only global AGENTS.md personal instructions are shown), evidence of uploading cloud files into a project, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
